name: Yahoo Webscope S5 Anomaly Detection Dataset
description: A collection of real and synthetic time series used to evaluate anomaly detection methods, including labeled anomalies in the real-world A1 series and synthetic A2–A4 series.
citation: Laptev, N., Amizadeh, S., & Flint, I. (2015). Generic and scalable framework for automated time-series anomaly detection. Proceedings of the 21st ACM SIGKDD International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining, 1939–1947. https://doi.org/10.1145/2783258.2788611
